summary: Probably John's 5th-great-grand-uncle (brother of Samuel Pringle); Revolutionary militia private, Orange County.
bio: The Prindle Genealogy lists Benjamin Prindle and David Prindle as privates, 1st Regt., Orange Co. Militia (land bounty rights). Round 2 suggested Benjamin as Samuel's father (Samuel named his son Benjamin); Round 3 downgraded this - FamilySearch lists Benjamin (1764) as a son of James Prindle, i.e. Samuel's brother.
